invariants.rule: Marketplace discovery, matching, participation, feedback and visibility semantics remain explicit and do not override Project/Merit/IAM ownership.

Composition never silently transfers semantic ownership: universal modules own their primitives, domains own their composition semantics, and composed members retain their own identities and contracts.

Containment, relation, dependency, composition and projection edges exist only through explicit typed references; naming, file hierarchy, UI adjacency or shared values never create semantic structure.

semantics.authority_rule: Participation evidence does not automatically grant Project administration rights.
semantics.authorization_rule: Participation does not automatically grant unrelated AccessCore rights.
semantics.employment_rule: Employment participation is represented within the employment Project/child Project structure.
semantics.identity_rule: Each material participation/contribution record has explicit evidence identity.
semantics.merit_rule: Participation alone does not create merit; actual evidence/outcomes feed MeritCore.
semantics.relation_rule: Participation is an explicit relation between identity and Project.
semantics.result_rule: Participation evidence is distinct from MeritCore merit calculation.
semantics.role_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Role/terms are explicit Project participation semantics. [2] Role/contribution semantics are explicit and domain/project-scoped.
semantics.time_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Participation interval may bound eligible Project evidence context. [2] Applicable week/hour atoms are explicit.
